name: Solar Energy Services, LLC.
old_description: Founded over a decade ago, Solar Energy Services has been dedicated to serving the Southwest Missouri region. Our unwavering commitment is to you, the customer concerned about the relentless rise in utility bills, fear of power outages, or seeking reliable energy solutions for remote areas. We understand that your primary concern is achieving energy independence while also being environmentally conscious. That’s why we’ve spent years perfecting our solar solutions, ensuring they are efficient and affordable. When you choose us, you’re choosing more than just a solar provider; you’re selecting a partner who will stand with you every step of the way. We’ll design a custom solar system tailored to your unique needs, ensuring you harness the full potential of solar energy.
about:
Solar Energy Services, LLC operates from Nixa, Missouri, serving the Southwest Missouri region since its founding in 2011. The family-owned business was established by master electrician Derek West and his wife Ashley; West brought over 17 years of solar industry experience to the venture.

The company designs and installs custom solar energy systems, including grid-tie arrays, off-grid solutions, battery backup storage, electric vehicle charging stations, and generator backup. Its technicians manage the full project lifecycle—from engineering and permitting through installation and ongoing maintenance—tailoring each system to the customer’s site and energy goals.

Customers range from homeowners and small businesses seeking lower utility bills to remote cabin owners and telecommunications sites requiring reliable off-grid power. The firm has also equipped water-heating systems and provided backup generation for residential and light-commercial clients across the region.

West’s master electrician license and Missouri state electrical contractor credential underpin the company’s emphasis on code-compliant, long-lasting installations built to perform for 25 years or more. The founders say they started the business to deliver dependable energy independence—whether for daily savings or catastrophic outage resilience—backed by hands-on technical support throughout the system’s life.
